_doc: P5 16/11 one-change experiment (user rule 16/11 05:30): = flow_p5_final_h with ONLY the model swapped: Qwen3.5-9B + V3A x0.70 / WL1 / WJR1 -> MoE E88 (13.96B) + its three LoRAs merged into FP8 (solver MS2W7 = MS2 at the framework's WiSE weight 0.70 like V3A x0.70, linker ML1, judge MJ2). Compatibility changes only: (1) the LoRAs are merged into the block-FP8 checkpoint (training/merge_fp8.py) and loaded by name (links_model / judge_model) instead of a vLLM LoRA on the 9B; (2) think_kw default: the 0.952 runs reasoned because the template thinks when enable_thinking is not passed (merged 9B dir has no 'qwen3' in its path); the MoE path contains 'qwen3', so 'default' restores the same behaviour.
